channel.title: ThisWeek Desktop Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the current ThisWeek desktop app.

item.description:
ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.15

Polish for calendar events and UI text selection.

  • Chrome UI (logo, headings, buttons) is no longer selectable; notes, Enhanced, transcripts, and Ask Anything replies still are.
  • Calendar event titles and times sit at the top of the event card.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.14

Keeps the calendar column focused on day view.

  • Removes the Day / Week / Month toggle from the single-column calendar.
  • Day / Week / Month remain available in the full calendar view.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.13

Calendar full view, smoother Enhanced notes, and several stability fixes.

  • Expand the calendar into a full main-pane view with Day / Week / Month in the header.
  • Opening notes with Enhanced no longer flashes My Note first, and the Enhanced toggle no longer flickers when switching notes.
  • Typing while saving no longer reverts the note to an older version (included from 0.1.12).
  • Settings overlays BlockNote toolbars correctly; right-click Inspect Element is disabled.
